content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Arvada

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of project management education hours. Importantly, no prior work experience is required—making CAPM ideal for career changers and those new to project management roles.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format compresses the required project management education into focused sessions, allowing you to move quickly from enrollment to exam readiness without disrupting your work schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, create your PMI account and submit your official application with documentation of your education hours. Pay the associated exam fee through PMI's portal. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through each submission requirement.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Test
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence in CAPM domains. Schedule your proctored exam when ready. Most candidates sit within two weeks of course completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll earn your CAPM credential valid for three years. Maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) through relevant training, volunteering, or professional activities. Renewal ensures your credential stays current and competitive.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
